description_en: Queries the list of protected IP addresses for a single Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 查询单个DDoS原生防护实例的防护IP列表
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-pack-ip-list --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePackIpList

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of protected IP addresses to return on each page. The maximum value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含受保护IP的数量。最大值：50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The protected IP address to query
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud asset to which the protected IP address belongs. Valid values:

ECS: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

SLB: a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

EIP: an Elastic IP Address (EIP) instance. Because Application Load Balancer (ALB) instances use EIPs, query the public IP address of an ALB instance using the EIP.

WAF: a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的受保护IP所属云资产类型。取值：

ECS：表示云服务器ECS实例。
SLB：表示传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例。
EIP：表示弹性公网IP实例。因公网应用型负载均衡ALB实例使用弹性公网IP，您需要通过EIP实例查询ALB的公网IP。
WAF：表示Web应用防火墙实例
parameters.name: product_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query the IDs of all regions that Anti-DDoS Origin supports
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account
parameters.name: member_uid

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code of the request.

For more information about status codes, see [Common parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118841.html）
Code.description_zh:
本次请求的HTTP状态码。

关于状态码的更多信息，请参见[公共参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118841.html）

IpList.description_en: The list of IP addresses that are protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
IpList.description_zh: 受DDoS原生防护实例保护的IP列表

MemberUid.description_en: The UID of the member account

NsmExpireAt.description_en: The end time of cross-border traffic blocking

NsmStartAt.description_en: The start time of cross-border traffic blocking

NsmStatus.description_en:
The status of cross-border traffic blocking. Valid values:

1: Cross-border traffic is being blocked.

0: Cross-border traffic is not blocked
NsmStatus.description_zh:
近源压制状态。取值：
1：表示正在近源压制中
0：表示未在近源压制中

Product.description_en:
The type of the cloud asset to which the IP address belongs. Valid values:

ECS: an ECS instance.

SLB: a CLB instance.

EIP: an EIP instance. This includes the EIP used by an ALB instance.

WAF: a WAF instance
Product.description_zh:
IP所属云资产的类型。取值：

ECS：表示云服务器ECS实例。
SLB：表示传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例。
EIP：表示弹性公网IP实例（包含应用型负载均衡ALB实例使用的弹性公网IP）。
WAF：表示Web应用防火墙实例

Region.description_en:
The region where the protected IP address is deployed.

This parameter is not returned if the protected IP address is deployed in the same region as the instance
Region.description_zh:
受保护IP的所在地域。
如果受保护IP所在地域和实例所在地域一致，则不返回该参数

Remark.description_en:
The remarks on the cloud asset to which the IP address belongs, such as an ECS instance or an SLB instance.

This parameter is not returned if no remarks are specified for the cloud asset
Remark.description_zh:
IP所属云资产（例如，ECS实例、SLB实例等）的备注。

如果云资产无备注，则不返回该参数

Status.description_en:
The current status of the IP address. Valid values:

normal: The IP address is not under attack.

hole_begin: The IP address is in blackhole filtering status
Status.description_zh:
IP的当前状态。取值：

normal：表示正常（未受攻击）。
hole_begin：表示正处于黑洞状态

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
本次请求是否调用成功。取值：

true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败。

Total.description_en: The number of protected IP addresses that are returned
Total.description_zh: 查询到的受保护IP的数量
